class.name: MaszynaE3DRailVehicleRenderingServer
class.brief_description: Draws MaSzyna vehicles as the original does.
class.description: Over [RailVehicleRenderingServer]'s drawing of the models and running gear: the pantographs, wipers, mirrors, doors, steps and pendulums animated from the vehicle's state, the couplers and hoses shown as they are coupled, the lamps and the smoke, the cargo, the coupler adapters fitted to the ends, and the low-poly cabs of the interior hidden and lit ([code]TDynamicObject[/code], [code]DynObj.cpp[/code]). What moves is found by the names the vehicle's MMD gives ([MaszynaRailVehicleAppearance]). Registered as [code]RailVehicleRenderingServer[/code] too, in its place.

method.name: cabin_set_light_level
method.description: The level (0-1) of the light of the [VehicleServer] [param cabin] its low-poly cab - of the cabin's kind ([RailVehicleServer]) - is lit at ([code]TDynamicObject::set_cab_lights()[/code], [code]DynObj.cpp:841-853[/code]); with [code]jointcabs:[/code] every cab at the brightest.

method.name: vehicle_set_load_model
method.description: The cargo, drawn at the floor of the vehicle; none for an empty file name.
